claim: AWS Client VPN supports authentication with Active Directory using AWS Directory Service, certificate-based authentication, and federated authentication using SAML-2.0.
q: Which authentication methods does AWS Client VPN support?
v: authentication with Active Directory using AWS Directory Services
ev: AWS Client VPN supports authentication with Active Directory using AWS Directory Services, Certificate-based authentication, and Federated Authentication using SAML-2.0.

claim: By default, split-tunnel on a Client VPN endpoint is disabled. You can turn it on for a new or an existing endpoint.
q: Is split tunnel enabled by default on a Client VPN endpoint?
v: By default, split-tunnel on a Client VPN endpoint is disabled
You can enable split-tunnel on a new or existing Client VPN endpoint
cond: enable at creation or modify later
ev: (Optional) To have the endpoint be a split-tunnel Client VPN endpoint, turn on Enable split-tunnel. By default, split-tunnel on a Client VPN endpoint is disabled.
